edges.reason: owner is initialized directly from msg.sender in the Ownable constructor.
FMC constructor assigns minted balances to msg.sender and checks _frozenAddress != msg.sender.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and credits recipients.
issue is privileged by onlyOwner which inspects msg.sender.
airdrop is privileged by onlyOwner which inspects msg.sender.
updateFrozenAddress is privileged by onlyOwner which inspects msg.sender.
defrozen is privileged by onlyOwner which inspects msg.sender.
getOwnAssets returns asset data for msg.sender.
setWebInfo is privileged by onlyOwner which inspects msg.sender.
transferOwnership is privileged by onlyOwner which inspects msg.sender.
transferFrom checks and updates allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
transfer compares now against _date0 to decide defrozing.
defrozen compares now against _date0 to decide defrozing.
getNow returns the block timestamp directly.
_getNow0 derives the current day zero from now.
the defrozing loop in transfer is driven by now.
the defrozing loop in defrozen is driven by now.
_getNow0 delegates computation to _calcDate0.
issue computes _now0 through _getNow0.
airdrop computes _now0 through _getNow0.
issue derives lock-up timestamps via deferDays[i]*24*3600 arithmetic.
transfer enters the timestamp-dependent defrozing loop over defrozenDates.
defrozen enters the timestamp-dependent defrozing loop over defrozenDates.
onlyOwner guards issue.
onlyOwner guards airdrop.
onlyOwner guards updateFrozenAddress.
onlyOwner guards defrozen.
onlyOwner guards setWebInfo.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer reads and updates the fellowInfo struct during defrozing.
issue mutates balances for owner, payees and frozenAddress.
issue records frozen values in fellowInfo.
airdrop mutates balances for owner, payees and frozenAddress.
airdrop records frozen values in fellowInfo.
defrozen reads and clears fellowInfo frozen entries.
getAssets reads fellowInfo to build the result arrays.
getOwnAssets delegates to getAssets.
updateFrozenAddress rewrites the frozenAddress state variable.
issue moves frozen tokens into frozenAddress balances.
defrozen releases tokens held by frozenAddress.
FMC constructor writes frozenAddress.
FMC constructor sets totalSupply_ to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
FMC constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the initial supply.
transferFrom debits the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination parameter only feeds the transfer function logic and should be folded into it.
Amount parameter only feeds the transfer function logic and should be folded into it.
Recipients array is only consumed by issue (shared with airdrop) and merges into the core function.
Amounts array is only consumed by issue and merges into the core function.
Lock-up days input feeds the timestamp arithmetic in issue and merges into it.
New frozen address is only used inside updateFrozenAddress.
Target fellow address is only used inside defrozen.
Local lock-up date is confined to the defrozing loop in defrozen.
Local released amount is confined to the defrozing loop in defrozen.
Storage Info reference is created inside transfer defrozing logic.
Accumulated airdrop amount is only used within airdrop.
Start-of-day timestamp is computed and consumed inside issue.
Existing frozen value lookup is only used within airdrop lock-up handling.
